page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head "VITA" centred at the top, the page number at the top left, and a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: non Parisiensibus solùm Theologis, operis sui approbatoribus, placere debuit; sed & Jesuitis, qui insignem adversus Janseni-stas victoriam reportaverant. Idcirco ne Sancyrani, Arnaldi, gregalis sui Segveno-ti, & aliorum, qui [?]e Augustini discipulos profitebantur, opiniones stabilire videretur, quasi commentaria sua de Sacramento poenitentiae eo dumtaxat fine in publicum edidisset, ut antiqua Ecclesiae praxis in Sacramenti illius Administratione revocaretur in usum, statim ab ingressu operis praefatus asserit, se illud ante annos 27. suscepisse, adeoq; neminem posse suspicari, quòd ob tumultus de poe-nis peccatis debitis recenter excitatos scripserit; & ut se à discipulis B. Augustini alienum ostenderet, ait, hactenus inauditum in Ecclesia, unius cujusdam Magistri, quantumlibet illustris, Doctrinam esse fidei regulam, in iis praesertim controversiis, in quibus caeteros Magistros sibi suisque discipulis habet contradicentes, eos demum, qui simile Augustino elogium tribuunt. ipsos esse infensiores illi-us

page.notes: Doubtful word: "qvi le" in the line "ti,& aliorum, qui le Augustini", where the second word could be "se" or another short word; I have written it as printed-looking and marked the first letter with [?]. The catchword "us" completes "illius" from the last line. The ampersands are printed as "&" and the abbreviation "adeoq;" is kept as printed.
